QuestInfo.name: The Mount in Danger
QuestInfo.0: Let's show your #t1902006# to #b#p1102002#, the Mount Instructor#k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1102002# says your Mount is suffering because you've gotten too strong for your Mount to keep up. He says he can try to recover your weakened Mount by putting the Mount inside a special Incubator, which will cost you a usage fee of #b50,000,000 Mesos#k.

0.0: A Mount is not just your ride but also your friend and companion. That is why your Mount is very dependent on you and easily affected by you. When you're strong, your Mount becomes strong. That's just how Mounts work. But, unfortunately, all Mounts have limits.
0.1: Your mount has also grown stronger alongside you... But you #bhave become too strong, and your mount has reached its limit#k. Yes, to put it simply, you have become more powerful than your mount can handle.
0.2: It's wonderful that you've become so strong, but your Mount is suffering because of it. We should tend to your Mount quickly. I'll first put your Mount in the special Incubator and see what I can do to recover its health. I don't know how effective this will be, but we should try everything we can, right?

yes.0: As you may have guessed, it will cost you some Mesos to use the Incubator. It will cost you even more to use the special Incubator, but what can you do? This is all for your Mount.
yes.1: I know it is a bit much, but bring me your #bMount along with 50,000,000 Mesos#k. I'll do everything I can to heal your Mount, so it can accompany you in your adventure.

no.0: *sigh* I can't guarantee anything, but what can we do? We don't have many options. We have to try everything we can.

1.0: Have you brought your Mount with you? Alright, it will be 50,000,000 Mesos. I'll put your Mount in the special Incubator.
